remarks: Welcome home to this spacious and sun-filled two-bedroom apartment ideally located in Glenbrook section of Stamford. This updated unit features a new kitchen with new stainless steel appliances. Updated full bathroom with tub. This unit offers a private balcony. perfect for relaxing and enjoying fresh air. One assigned parking space is included for added convenience. Rent includes heat (up to 55 degrees), hot water and cold water. The building offers community laundry and is professionally managed. Storage space subject to availability. Enjoy a prime location close to the Glenbrook Train Station, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, parks, public transportation and major commuter routes including I-95, Route 1. Making daily commuting easy and efficient. Unpack and enjoy comfortable city living in Stamford
